description: Connects this computer to Tag Pilot Search Console MCP (free Tag Pilot account + read-only Google Search Console access). Call it when the user asks to connect, or when another tool says the computer is not connected. It returns a link and a code: show both to the user as given (a clickable link), ask them to open it, approve and allow Google access, and tell you when done; then call connection_status. Never ask the user to run terminal commands. If already connected, it says so.
name: connect
title: Connect Search Console MCP
